dedupe_keys.name: cwasi database virtual water trade and consumptive water footprint of agricultural products politecnico di torino

description: CWASI is a harmonised database of water footprints and virtual water trade for hundreds of agricultural products (crops, crop-derived products, livestock and livestock-derived products, edible and non-edible), developed in the EU-funded CWASI project. The Zenodo record, published on 18 April 2019 by Stefania Tamea, Irene Soligno, Marta Tuninetti and Francesco Laio (Politecnico di Torino), is titled for 1961 to 2013 while the description says 1961 to 2016; its files are restricted, so access must be requested through Zenodo, and no licence or file list is shown on the page read. Keywords include virtual water, food trade, water footprint and crop water use efficiency. Coverage is global, by country and product. Caveats: files are not openly available, the covered years differ between title and description, and the method is described in the related publications. For simulation it gives country-to-country flows of water embedded in food trade, to test how droughts in exporting regions pass through trade to importers. Related catalogue records include the virtual water flows dataset for 1996 to 2005, WaterStat product water footprints and FABIO.
